description: Use when the customer describes a trip instead of a size: the countries (with the days in each, when known) and how they use data (usage light / normal / heavy, or gb_per_day). Sizes the shared pool from the trip length and returns three server-quoted routes — exact, comfortable (×1.5) and generous (×2) — each with the pool in GB, the full price, a one-line reason and its buy_url, plus an optional budget check. Same prices as quote_route.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

budget.description: Optional budget for the whole route in the quoted currency; options above it are marked.

days.description: Trip length in days (1–90). Give days, or days_in_country on the countries (then the trip length is their sum). With neither, the call fails with invalid_argument asking for days.

gb_per_day.description: Optional: the customer's own estimate in GB per day (wins over usage).

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

route.description: The countries of the trip in travel order (1–8, each once).

days_in_country.description: Days the customer spends in this country. Without days, the trip length is the sum of the days_in_country given; with neither, the call fails with invalid_argument and asks for days.

destination.description: Country in ANY language or its ISO code, e.g. "Vietnam", "Viêt Nam", "vn". Map a city to its country first.

networks.description: Optional: operator names (or codes) from get_networks for this country. Omit = its cheapest network.

usage.description: light ≈ 0.5 GB/day, normal ≈ 1.5 GB/day (default), heavy ≈ 4 GB/day.

name: recommend_config
title: Recommend a route
